## tfskel init

Initialize tfskel project structure

### Synopsis

Initializes a new Terraform monorepo with an environment-and-region-based
directory layout with sensible defaults already in place.

Generates a .mise.toml file declaring all required tools (terraform, tflint,
trivy, pre-commit, awscli) so they can be installed with a single command:

  mise install

Tool versions default to "latest". After creation, .mise.toml is user-owned —
edit it directly to pin specific versions.

```
tfskel init [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Initialize in current directory (uses .tfskel.yaml if present)
  tfskel init

  # Initialize in specific directory
  tfskel init --dir /path/to/project

  # Initialize with explicit config file
  tfskel init --config /path/to/config.yaml
```

### Options

```
  -d, --dir string    directory to initialize (default: current directory)
      --force         overwrite files even without source markers (requires --upgrade)
  -h, --help          help for init
      --skip string   comma-separated files to skip during upgrade (requires --upgrade)
      --upgrade       overwrite init-managed files with latest versions from this binary
      --workflows     generate shared GitHub workflow files (reusable workflows and lint)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -c, --config string   config file (default is .tfskel.yaml in current directory)
      --dry-run         show what would happen without writing files
      --no-color        disable colored output (respects NO_COLOR and FORCE_COLOR env vars)
  -v, --verbose         enable verbose output
```
